text:
jess: Quick sync — need final landing copy pass for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private before launch posts. Also: webinar CTA + inbound routing mapping. Can we lock CTAs + 2 headline variants today?

omar: timeline? launch posts go live next Tue. webinar scheduled Thu. Need lead routing rules by EOD Wed.

taylor: pushing hero comps now, two tonalities: 'speed + predictability' vs 'control + compliance'. leaning toward speed for Hosted, control for Private.

ravi: for launch posts, we should run 2 benchmark narratives: 1) latency/cost microbench vs cloud baseline, 2) failure-stress case (fallbacks). short social blurbs + 1pager.

alexa: Suggested CTAs
- Hosted: `Start free` (instant key) 
- Dedicated: `Reserve capacity` (lead form) 
- Private: `Request private trial` (sales qual)
I added sample copy in the doc: https://docs.google.com/example-landing-copy

taylor: draft hero lines
- Hosted: 'Build fast with low-latency hosted inference'
- Dedicated: 'Predictable throughput, reserved capacity'
- Private: 'Fully private deployment with audit controls'

jess: ok good. Ravi — outline lead routing.

ravi: Proposed routing rules (simple):
```
if source == 'organic' and plan == 'Hosted' -> marketing-ops@ (email drip)
if plan == 'Dedicated' -> sdr@ + tag: 'capacity-inquiry'
if plan == 'Private' -> solutions-eng@ + enterprise-sales@ (high-touch)
if webinar_signup -> webinar-nurture@ -> then sdr if demo requested
```

ravi: Also push UTM schema: `utm_campaign=prod-launch-2026&utm_content={hero_variant}`

omar: We need wire for form fields: company size, infra constraints, compliance reqs (yes/no). Keeps routing deterministic.

taylor: added form mock in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/example

alexa: small code snippet for docs CTA on hero (inline):
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'`

jess: action items
- taylor: finalize hero comps by 5pm
- alexa: publish doc excerpt + inline code by EOD
- ravi: finalize routing rules + UTM spec by EOD
- omar: wire up form fields with eng
I'll assemble launch post drafts once those land. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Reminder: webinar scheduled Thu 16:00 UTC. Auto-email sequence starts Wed 09:00 UTC.

taylor: noted, will drop final assets.

ravi: will post routing matrix in #marketing-assets when ready.

jess: thx all — quick sync at 3pm if we need to unblock.
